image.alt: Four fossil hominin skull casts standing in a row on plain mounts, unlabelled, from the smallest and most forward-jawed on the left to the roundest-skulled and flat-faced on the right.

habilis.alt: A single small-brained fossil skull cast in profile: small rounded cranium, jaw projecting forward, and a heavy shelf of bone over the eye sockets.

erectus.alt: A single fossil skull cast in profile with a long, low, enlarged braincase, a thick continuous brow ridge, and a face shorter than the first skull's.

neanderthal.alt: A single large fossil skull cast in profile with a bulge at the back of the braincase, a sweeping curved double brow ridge, and a broad nasal opening.

sapiens.alt: A modern human skull in profile with a high vertical forehead, a rounded globular cranium, a flat straight face, a small brow ridge and a projecting chin.

trend.alt: Four fossil hominin skull casts standing in a row on plain mounts, oldest left to newest right, so the changes in forehead height, brow ridge size and facial profile can be compared directly.
